Name: Avatar Hamster Panic
Overview: Avatar Hamster Panic is a multiplayer action minigame. Up to four players, including bots, controls their avatar, who is inside a large plastic hamster ball. The goal is to move downward through platforms, collecting milkshakes for points. Along the way, there are also items that periodically appear, and whoever grabs them can use them to attack the other players, such as by shrinking them or freezing them in place temporarily. Each player also has a limited boost meter which can be used to either move quickly to the sides or to jump, and will refill when not in use. The game ends when a player collects the golden milkshake, which is worth a points bonus but does not decide the winner outright.
